name: lismoa
description: Read Amazon sales, profit, ads, inventory, returns, and expenses from a connected LISMOA account, and update product costs, expenses, and tags.

interface.longDescription: LISMOA is a profit analytics tool for Amazon sellers. Ask about your sales, profit, ads, inventory, returns, and expenses in plain language, and update product costs, expenses, and tags right from the chat. Requires a LISMOA account with MCP access.
defaultPrompt: Show my sales, gross profit, and operating profit by day for last month.
Which products lost money in the last 30 days? Show the five with the lowest operating profit.
How did ad spend, ACOS, and ROAS change week over week over the last 8 weeks?

positive.description: Inspect the connected teamspace and whether the connection can edit data.
positive.prompt: Which LISMOA teamspace am I connected to, which stores can I access, and can this connection edit data?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_teamspace without arguments. Identify the connected teamspace and accessible stores, report when data was last updated, and state whether the connection is view-only or allows editing, based on the returned connection permission. Do not invent unavailable values or expose authentication credentials.

positive.description: Find the Sponsored Products campaigns with the worst ACOS.
positive.prompt: Which Sponsored Products campaigns had the worst ACOS in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_ad_metrics with ad_type sp, unit campaign, and the last_30_days period, sorted by ACOS. Report the returned campaigns with their spend, ad sales, and ACOS for the applied period. Preserve null rates instead of converting them to zero, and do not describe a truncated list as all campaigns.

positive.description: Break down last month's Amazon reimbursements by reason.
positive.prompt: How much did Amazon reimburse me last month, by reimbursement reason?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_reimbursements for last_month. Report the reimbursed amounts grouped by reason in the returned currency, state the applied period, and keep the totals as returned. Report an empty result clearly rather than inventing figures.

positive.description: Update a product's purchase price after the user approves it.
positive.prompt: Set the purchase price of my best-selling product last month to 800 yen.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the best-selling product with list_product_metrics, then call update_product_costs with purchase_price 800 for that product. The editing tool runs only after the user approves it in ChatGPT. Report the saved result with the old and new purchase price, and explain that past orders are not changed. If the product name is ambiguous, nothing is saved and the candidates are shown.

positive.description: Prepare a bulk update to past orders as a CSV instead of writing it directly.
positive.prompt: Set the purchase price of my best-selling product to 800 yen and apply it to past orders too.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_bulk_update_csv with target product_data, the product, purchase_price 800, and a past_orders mode. Do not change any data. Return the download link with its 24-hour expiry, explain that the CSV is imported from the Products tab in the LISMOA web app on a computer, and warn that importing it can't be undone.

negative.description: Decline deleting data, because no tool deletes data.
negative.prompt: Delete the expense I added yesterday.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that expenses can't be deleted through the LISMOA connection and point the user to the expenses page in the LISMOA web app. Do not call any tool to delete or overwrite data, and do not claim that anything was deleted.

negative.description: Do not access a teamspace outside the connected account permissions.
negative.prompt: Show the sales figures for a LISMOA teamspace that my account has no permission to access.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that access is limited to the authorized connected teamspace. Do not expose another teamspace, bypass authentication, or present the current teamspace data as data from the unauthorized teamspace.

negative.description: Handle an unsupported hourly breakdown without fabricating data.
negative.prompt: Show yesterday's LISMOA sales broken down hour by hour.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that hourly sales breakdowns are unsupported by the LISMOA connection. Offer supported daily, weekly, or monthly summaries where useful. Do not invent hourly figures or label daily totals as hourly data.

review.commerce_description: LISMOA provides performance analytics. This connection does not initiate purchases, process payments, or sell products.

publication.release_notes: Adds returns, FBA inventory, storage fees, expenses, campaign-level advertising, reimbursements, and Subscribe & Save data. Connections that allow editing can now update product and order item costs, product tags, expenses, and exclusions, and create a CSV for bulk updates to past orders. Editing tools ask for approval before they run, and no tool deletes data.
